neighbours.label: The verb of a 'which/that' relative clause that relates an organization or place to the people or things it covers ('the union which represents', 'the habitat in which ... lives'), vs the same nouns with a main-clause verb
fire: The council which governs the island approved a new ferry timetable last week.
Members of the federation which represents dock workers voted to accept the offer.
The agency which regulates drinking water issued a warning to three towns.
The association which represents most of the country's nurses called for more staff.
Officials from the board which oversees the national parks visited the site.
The guild which represents the city's taxi drivers held a rally on Tuesday.
The authority which manages the harbour raised its fees for small boats.
Leaders of the alliance which represents rural farmers met the minister.
quiet: The island council approved a new ferry timetable at its meeting last week.
Dock workers in the federation voted on Monday to accept the offer.
The water agency issued a warning to three towns after heavy rain.
The country's nurses' association called for more staff in its annual report.
Officials from the national parks board visited the site on Friday.
The city's taxi drivers' guild held a rally outside the town hall on Tuesday.
The harbour authority raised its fees for small boats this spring.
Rural farmers' leaders met the minister in the capital yesterday.
